rationale: The agent authenticated the user properly by matching full name and zip to a unique account before taking any action. They reviewed the user’s orders with read-only tools and identified the relevant pending order. Before attempting any change, the agent stated the exact items to cancel and received explicit confirmation. The attempted partial cancellation failed due to tool constraints (exchange-only behavior requiring one-to-one item replacement). The agent did not fabricate a successful change; instead, they clearly explained the limitation and offered compliant alternatives (cancel entire order or exchange variants). The user chose to keep the order and requested a default address update. The agent confirmed the specific Seattle address and received explicit “yes” before performing the write, then executed modify_user_address successfully and confirmed the update. No actions were taken without confirmation, no unsupported claims about order status or refunds were made post-failure, and the final state reflects the user’s choice under the system’s constraints.
